title: PIMENT INTERIM (GROUPE PIMENT)
description: Piment Interim is a French temporary employment and recruitment agency founded in 2003. It provides interim staffing, permanent and fixed-term placements, and related HR services across industry, commerce, services and aeronautics. The group operates under the brands Piment and Optima with a network of agencies in France.*once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator https://www.groupepiment.fr/
